ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels comprise >95% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the terminal tips and in localized micro-flecks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-contrast white blobs are located at the distal tips of both lobes. A cluster of irregular white mottling is visible at the extreme left tip, while the extreme right tip shows a more fragmented white pattern. Scattered white punctate marks are distributed across the black field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A wide, shallow U-shaped depression is visible, though the lower vertex is partially obscured by water spray and surface turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, irregular serrations are present along the continuous trailing edge, with higher frequency peaks observed toward the distal lobe tips compared to the smoother region near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the outer tips tapering symmetrically toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly concentrated white pixel clusters are detected at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with localized scarring or barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four parallel, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the mid-left lobe. Fainter, unaligned linear marks are visible on the central right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white scarring at both distal tips; distinct parallel rake marks on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Widespread distribution of small, white punctate pixel clusters across the black ventral field.
